items.code: - `F02.checklist-dismiss`: hovering or focusing the card (expanded or minimized) reveals an X (`Dismiss checklist`) in its header; touch devices always show it. Clicking it hides the card for good (it stays hidden after a reload) and turns off the **Show Getting Started checklist** switch in Settings → Application, which brings the card back in its previous expanded or minimized state (#18185).
- The **Getting started** card: click an item row to go to its page, or hover it for the preview; hover the card for the X that dismisses it.

- **Dismiss (`F02.checklist-dismiss`).** On `/conversations`, `control-openhands browser count 'role=button[name="Dismiss checklist"]'` is `0` (the X is `opacity-0` and `invisible` until the card is hovered). Run `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=command-menu-trigger'`, `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=sidebar-onboarding-checklist-toggle'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'role=button[name="Dismiss checklist"]' --state visible --timeout 5000` (`browser screenshot 'aside[data-collapsed]' --feature F02.checklist-dismiss --name hover-close`). Run `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Dismiss checklist"]'`: `browser count 'testid=sidebar-onboarding-checklist'` is `0`, still `0` after `control-openhands browser reload`, and `browser storage` lists `openhands-sidebar-onboarding-checklist-dismissed`. On `/settings/app`, `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=show-getting-started-checklist-switch]').checked"` is `false`; `control-openhands browser click 'text=Show Getting Started checklist'` brings the card back. Minimized: `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sidebar-onboarding-checklist-toggle'` (`data-minimized` `true`), hover as above, click the X (count `0`), click the switch text again: the card returns with `data-minimized` `true`; click the toggle to expand it. At phone width the X shows in the drawer's card the same way.

- **Error toast (`F02.error-toasts`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001` and `control-openhands browser wait-text 'This conversation does not exist'`. The URL becomes `/conversations`, and `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F02.error-toasts --name missing-conversation` shows a top-right error toast. It is the only toast: `control-openhands browser toasts` lists just the "This conversation does not exist, or you do not have permission to access it…" text, and `control-openhands browser toasts --history` has no entry containing `this UI does not understand`. `control-openhands browser wait 'text=This conversation does not exist' --state hidden` passes within 30 s. Light theme: arrange `control-openhands browser eval "localStorage.setItem('openhands-color-theme','light-plus')"`, repeat the `goto`, and read `control-openhands browser eval "(()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=status]')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('does not exist'));return getComputedStyle(t).color+' on '+getComputedStyle(t.closest('div[style]')).backgroundColor})()"`: `rgb(31, 31, 31) on rgb(229, 229, 229)`: every toast uses the theme's high-emphasis ink (`--oh-contrast`) on its surface (#18387, fixed by #18403; the error toast is no longer muted, so the default theme reads `rgb(255, 255, 255) on rgb(49, 49, 49)`). A success toast reads the same: save any change on `/settings/app` (for example `control-openhands browser click 'testid=app-settings-screen >> text=Sound Notifications'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button'`, then toggle it back and save again) and read the `Settings saved` toast the same way: `rgb(31, 31, 31) on rgb(229, 229, 229)`. Solarized Light (`solarized-light`) gives `rgb(0, 43, 54) on rgb(230, 223, 204)` for both toasts. Restore with `browser eval "localStorage.removeItem('openhands-color-theme')"`.

- Dismissing the checklist with its X and the App settings switch write the same browser-local flag, so either one undoes the other. Clicking **Join the OpenHands Slack** counts as joining and opens an external tab you must close.

Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=home-launcher-mode-automate'`: Automate is checked, the placeholder is `What work do you want to automate?`, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=home-composer-actions' aria-disabled` is `true`, and `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=open-workspace-button'` and `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=open-plugin-picker'` are `false` (`browser screenshot --feature F03.launcher-mode-toggle --name automate`). `control-openhands browser reload` brings Code back (`browser attr 'testid=home-launcher-mode-code' aria-checked` is `true`). Light theme: arrange `control-openhands browser eval "localStorage.setItem('openhands-color-theme','light-plus')"` and `browser reload`, then `control-openhands browser eval "getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid=home-launcher-mode-code]')).color"` and `browser screenshot 'testid=home-launcher-mode-toggle' --feature F03.launcher-mode-toggle --name light-plus-code`. Restore with `browser eval "localStorage.removeItem('openhands-color-theme')"` and `browser reload`.

- **Automation setup tag (`F04.automation-setup-tag`).** Arrange one setup conversation through the setup page (F22): `control-openhands browser goto /automations`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation-create' --expect-url '/automations/setup'`, then `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt 'Reply with only the word ok. Do not run any tools.' --wait --timeout 180` (one tiny model call; note `<setup-id>`). `control-openhands api GET /api/conversations/<setup-id> --pick tags` has `automationsetup: draft`. In the sidebar, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Reply >> testid=conversation-card-tag-chip'` is `Automation setup: Draft` (the first chip; the internal draft-id keys stay hidden). Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=tag-filters-section'`: the facet `testid=tag-facet-row-automationsetup=draft` reads `Automation setup: Draft`; click it, `control-openhands browser press Escape`, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-active-tag-filters'` is `Automation setup: Draft` and `Clear all`, with only setup conversations (and pinned rows) left; `control-openhands browser click 'testid=active-tag-filter-automationsetup=draft'` removes it. After `control-openhands browser mouse-click 900 900`, `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Reply'` lists `Automation setup` and the raw value `draft` (`browser screenshot --feature F04.automation-setup-tag --name facet`). End with `control-openhands browser goto /`; since #18392 the setup send leaves no Home draft, and since #18385 opening another conversation from the sidebar leaves that conversation's tags alone (see Gotchas).

- Opening a conversation from the sidebar never changes its tags, also right after an automation setup conversation (one tagged `automationsetup: draft`): the other conversation keeps its tags and opens as a normal chat (#18378, fixed by #18385; recipe in F07 `F07.open-by-url`). A conversation that did get the tag loses it with Edit tags (`remove-tag-automationsetup`).

- **Home draft (`F05.draft-persistence`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'QA home draft'`, `control-openhands browser goto /settings/secrets`, `control-openhands browser goto /`, then the `innerText` eval: `QA home draft`; `control-openhands browser storage --session` lists `oh:home-prompt-draft`. The automation setup page's docked composer (`/automations/setup`, F22) keeps no draft and never touches the Home one (#18379, fixed by #18392). With `QA home draft` still in the Home composer, run `control-openhands browser goto /automations`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation-create' --expect-url '/automations/setup'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-input'`: the `innerText` eval is empty. `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only the word ok2. Do not run any tools.'`, then `control-openhands browser eval "new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(sessionStorage.getItem('oh:home-prompt-draft')),1500))"` still returns `QA home draft`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sidebar-conversations-link' --expect-url '/conversations(\?|$)'`: the Home composer shows `QA home draft`. Clear it (`fill 'testid=chat-input' ''`, wait a second) and repeat the setup send: New Chat is empty and `browser storage --session --values` has no `oh:home-prompt-draft`. Unsent text in the setup composer is lost when the user leaves that page (by design, #18392).

- **Attach a file and an image (`F05.attach-files`).** On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser upload 'testid=upload-image-input' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-image.png" "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt"` and `control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box' --feature F05.attach-files --name attached`: a `qa-note.txt TXT` chip and a thumbnail. `control-openhands browser count 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> alt=qa-image.png'` is `1`. `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Upload as file"]'` turns the image toggle into `Do not upload as file` (`control-openhands browser attr 'role=button[name="Do not upload as file"]' aria-pressed` is `true`); click it again to restore. The remove buttons are named: `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` lists `button "Remove qa-note.txt"` and `button "Remove image"`. Remove the image with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> role=button[name="Remove image"]'`; the `alt=qa-image.png` count is `0`. Then `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only the content of the attached file.'`, `control-openhands browser press Enter --selector 'testid=chat-input'`, wait as in Type and send, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=user-message >> nth=-1'`: it ends `NEW FILES ADDED: qa-note.txt`. `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent --last 3` shows the reply `QA attachment 7731`, and `qa-note.txt` sits in the conversation `workspace` printed by `control-openhands conversation status <id>`. Attachments added on Home before the conversation exists upload after it is created: with no workspace or a Local Repo workspace they land in it (`browser network --filter upload` shows `200`). Expected: the same in New Worktree mode. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-14, #18421): run `control-openhands fixture git-repo --name qa-repo`, `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands workspace open qa-repo`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-mode-selector'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-mode-selector-option-new_worktree'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'`, `control-openhands browser upload-via 'testid=add-files-and-images-button' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt"`, type `Reply with only the word received. Do not run any tools.` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=home-chat-launcher >> testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/[^/]+$'`: `control-openhands browser toasts --history` shows `HTTP request failed (422 Unprocessable Entity): {"detail":"path must be inside the conversation workspace"}` and `browser network --filter upload` a `422` for `?path=<run>/workspace/qa-repo/qa-note.txt`, while `conversation status <id>` reports the worktree `/tmp/conversation-worktrees/<id>/qa-repo`; the message is sent without the file. The same file attached inside that conversation afterwards uploads to the worktree (`200`). Restore with `testid=workspace-mode-selector-option-local_repo`.

- `F06.confirmation-mode`: with confirmation mode on, a lock chip sits above the composer and each action waits for "Do you want to continue with this action?" with Cancel and Continue (hints `⇧⌘⌫` / `⌘↩` on macOS, `Ctrl+⇧+⌫` / `Ctrl+↩` elsewhere, hidden below 640 px); a cancelled action is marked Rejected and counts as resolved in its group.

- **Long table cell (`F06.markdown-rendering`).** On the stream conversation write a prompt file whose first line is `Reply with only the word OK. Do not run any tools.`, then a blank line and the table `| Name | Description | Status |`, `|---|---|---|`, `| Alpha | This is a really long sentence in a single cell that goes on and on to explain a very involved aspect of the system, which nobody could read on one line without scrolling forever to the right. | ok |`, `| Beta | brief | fail |`. Run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' x --value-file <file>`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button'` and `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --fresh --timeout 120`; the user bubble renders the table. Cells wrap once they reach 28rem (`max-w-md`; #18356, fixed by #18357): `control-openhands browser eval "getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid=markdown-table-scroll] td')).whiteSpace + ' ' + getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid=markdown-table-scroll] td')).maxWidth"` is `normal 448px`. At desktop with the right panel closed, `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=user-message >> nth=-1 >> testid=markdown-table-scroll'` has `scrollWidth` `582` equal to `clientWidth` and `Status` is visible (`browser screenshot 'testid=chat-interface' --feature F06.markdown-rendering --name long-cell-table`). A table still wider than the conversation keeps the horizontal scroll with its edge fade: with the panel open (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=right-panel-toggle'`) `clientWidth` is `474`, and at phone width `326`, so `Status` is scrolled off there while the long cell stays wrapped. An agent reply with such a table behaves the same.

- **Confirmation mode on (`F06.confirmation-mode`).** Arrange through the settings UI, in this order (the Security Analyzer field appears only once Confirmation Mode is on): `control-openhands browser goto /settings/verification`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> text=Confirmation Mode'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sdk-section-all-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> role=button[name="Show suggestions"]'`, `control-openhands browser click 'role=listbox >> role=option[name="None"]'`, `control-openhands browser value 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> role=combobox[name="Security Analyzer"]'` (`None`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> testid=save-button'`; `control-openhands api GET /api/settings` shows `"confirmation_mode": true` and `"security_analyzer": "none"` (None means every action is confirmed; the default LLM analyzer only stops HIGH-risk actions, so `echo` would run unprompted). Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run the terminal command 'echo qa-confirm-ok' and reply with its output." --wait --timeout 180`: it returns `"status": "waiting_for_confirmation"`. `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` ends `Do you want to continue with this action? Cancel Ctrl+⇧+⌫ Continue Ctrl+↩` on Linux (`Cancel ⇧⌘⌫ Continue ⌘↩` on macOS, #18127), `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=action-confirm-button'` is `Confirm the requested action`, and a lock icon sits above the composer (screenshot). The tooltip stays open over the Cancel button, so move the pointer first: `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=chat-input'`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=action-reject-button'`: status `idle`, the buttons are gone, `conversation events <id> --last 6` ends with `UserRejectObservation`, and the action's row reads `Rejected` (`control-openhands browser count 'testid=rejected-indicator'` is `1`) with no spinner. Send `Run the terminal command 'echo qa-confirm-two' and reply with its output.` through `testid=chat-input` / `testid=submit-button`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button' --timeout 20000`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=action-confirm-button'`; about 15 s later the status is `finished` and the events contain the observation `qa-confirm-two`. A rejection inside a group resolves it too (#17920, fixed by #17995): send `Run the terminal command 'echo qa-g1'. After it finishes, run the terminal command 'echo qa-g2' as a separate tool call. Then reply DONE.`, continue the first action (`browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button'`, then `control-openhands browser press Control+Enter`, which is also the next bullet's shortcut) and cancel the second (`browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button' --timeout 60000`, `control-openhands browser press Control+Shift+Backspace`): status `idle`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1'` ends `2 actions completed`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1 >> .animate-spin'` is `0`, the same after `browser reload`, and the expanded group (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1 >> button >> nth=0'`) shows `Rejected` on the `qa-g2` row (`browser screenshot 'testid=chat-interface' --feature F06.confirmation-mode --name group-after-reload`). Each button keeps its label and hint on one line (#18395, fixed by #18397): while the prompt is waiting, `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=action-reject-button],[data-testid=action-confirm-button]')].map(b=>b.offsetHeight+'/'+b.scrollHeight).join(' ')"` is `26/26 26/26` at desktop, also with the side panel open (`testid=right-panel-toggle`). At phone width (`browser viewport phone`) the shortcut hints are hidden (no hardware keyboard), the buttons read `Cancel` and `Continue`, and `browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` ends `Do you want to continue with this action? Cancel Continue` (screenshot the awaiting prompt at phone width).

- **Leaving an automation setup conversation (`F07.open-by-url`).** A conversation tagged `automationsetup: draft` (started from `/automations/setup`, see `F04.automation-setup-tag`) opens as a setup page (`testid=automation-setup-topbar`, no `chat-pane-header`). Make an empty conversation: `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-panel-new-thread-picker'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=launch-no-workspace' --expect-url '/conversations/'` (note `<plain-id>`; `control-openhands api GET /api/conversations/<plain-id> --pick tags` is only `clientsource`). Open the setup conversation from the sidebar (`control-openhands browser click 'a[href*="/conversations/<setup-id>"] >> nth=0' --expect-url '/conversations/<setup-id>'`), then go back the same way (`'a[href*="/conversations/<plain-id>"] >> nth=0'`). Expected: `<plain-id>` opens as a normal conversation: `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-pane-header'`, `browser count 'testid=chat-pane-header'` is `1`, `browser count 'testid=automation-setup-topbar'` is `0`, and `api GET /api/conversations/<plain-id> --pick tags` is still only `clientsource`, also after `browser reload` and after repeating the round trip; the sidebar row of `<plain-id>` has no `Automation setup: Draft` chip (`browser screenshot --feature F07.open-by-url --name plain-stays-plain`). The setup conversation is in this tab's `openhands-automation-setup-handoffs` sessionStorage entry during the check (`control-openhands browser storage --session --values`), the state that used to re-tag the other conversation (#18378, fixed by #18385). The same holds at phone width through the sidebar drawer (`sidebar-mobile-menu-toggle`, then the rows inside `testid=sidebar-mobile-drawer`).

- **Agent tools (`F07.agent-tools-modal`).** Open the menu, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=show-agent-tools-button'`; the dialog `testid=system-message-modal` has tabs `System Message` (selected, the system prompt) and `Available Tools`. `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> role=tab[name="Available Tools"]'`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=system-message-modal >> testid=toggle-button'` (backend-provided count; `10` on Agent Server 1.54.0: terminal, file_editor, task_tracker, canvas_ui_control, launch_child_conversation, request_secret (local backends, #18408, see `F14.agent-request`), finish, think, switch_llm, invoke_skill), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=system-message-modal >> testid=toggle-button >> nth=0'` expands `terminal` with its description. Close with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=close-system-message-modal'`.

- The Overview drawer has no Automations, Skills, MCP or Secrets sections: #18406 removed them (they had no opener). The Overview menu offers Workspace and Git rows only, and its drawer opens only Pull Requests (`F27.overview-drawer`).

- Dialogs move focus inside when they open and keep Tab inside (#18400): the Skills and Hooks dialogs start on their close button, Stop and Delete on `cancel-button`, Export on `close-transcript-export-modal`, Agent Tools on `close-system-message-modal`. In the Hooks dialog, focusing Refresh with Tab opens its tooltip, which takes the first Escape; a second Escape closes the dialog.

- **File discovery (`F08.files-discovery-settings`).** With the drawer open on Files (open it with `right-panel-toggle` and click `testid=conversation-tab-files` only if Files is not already the active tab: clicking the active tab closes the drawer), run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=file-discovery-settings'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog[name="File discovery"]'`: `Applies to this workspace on this backend, including other conversations using it.`, textbox `Excluded directories` (`.git`, `node_modules`, `.venv`, … `target`), spinbutton `Maximum files (0 for unlimited)` `2000`, checkbox `Include symbolic links to files`, buttons `Restore defaults`, `Cancel`, `Save`. With `D='role=dialog[name="File discovery"]'`: `control-openhands browser fill "$D >> role=spinbutton" '-1'` makes `control-openhands browser enabled "$D >> role=button[name=\"Save\"]"` `false`; `2000` makes it `true`. Run `control-openhands browser fill "$D >> role=textbox" "$(printf '.git\nnode_modules\nsrc')"` and click Save: the dialog closes, `control-openhands api GET /api/settings` holds `workspace_file_discovery` keyed by the workspace path with `excludedPatterns` `.git`, `node_modules`, `src`, and after `control-openhands browser click 'testid=files-tab-refresh'` `control-openhands browser count 'testid=file-tree-dir-src'` is `0`, also after `browser reload` and reopening the drawer (`browser screenshot --feature F08.files-discovery-settings --name dialog` before saving). Restore: reopen the dialog, click `Restore defaults` (the textbox returns to the default list; the dialog stays open), then `Save`; after Refresh the `file-tree-dir-src` count is `1`. `control-openhands browser press Escape` closes the dialog without saving. At phone width the dialog fits the viewport: on the 390 px `/panel` page (`control-openhands browser viewport phone`, `browser goto /conversations/<id>/panel`, `browser click 'testid=conversation-tab-files'`, then `file-discovery-settings`) `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=file-discovery-settings-modal'` is about 351 px wide at x about 20 with `insideViewport` `true` (520 px at desktop), and `browser screenshot --feature F08.files-discovery-settings --name phone-fits` shows the title, the textbox and `Restore defaults`, `Cancel`, `Save` whole. Measure the `file-discovery-settings-modal` test id: `role=dialog` is the full-screen backdrop. Focus starts in the dialog (the Excluded directories textbox) and Tab cycles its fields and buttons without leaving it.

- **Name rules (`F10.name-validation`).** In the editor run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=profile-name-input' 'QA bad'`; `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=save-profile-btn'` is `false` and `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=profile-name-input' aria-invalid` is `true` (the same for `-QA` and a 65-character name), and the rule text under the field turns to the theme's danger colour: `control-openhands browser eval "(()=>{const i=document.querySelector('[data-testid=profile-name-input]');return getComputedStyle(document.getElementById(i.getAttribute('aria-describedby'))).color+' '+getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--oh-color-danger')})()"` reads `rgb(231, 106, 94) #e76a5e` on OpenHands-Neutral and `rgb(209, 52, 56) #D13438` on Light+ (`F16.color-theme`) (#18199); a valid name turns it back to the muted grey. An existing name (`QA_flash`) also gives `enabled` `false` and `aria-invalid` `true`, with a role=alert message under the field in the danger colour while the rule text stays grey. The message reads `An LLM profile with this name already exists. Choose a different name, or edit the existing one.` (#18411; `browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert]')].map(a=>a.innerText+' | '+getComputedStyle(a).color)"`; screenshot `--feature F10.name-validation --name duplicate-neutral`). `QA_flash2` gives `true` and no message.

- **New profile prefill (`F10.create-prefill`).** With that Default (temperature `0.3`) run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=add-llm-profile'`. The editor opens on All (`browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].map(t=>t.innerText+':'+t.getAttribute('aria-selected')).join(',')"` is `Basic:false,Advanced:false,All:true`), `browser value 'testid=llm-custom-model-input'` is the backend default `openai/gpt-5.6-sol`, and `control-openhands assert --field value --equals 0.3 -- browser value 'testid=sdk-settings-llm.temperature'` passes: the temperature is inherited from the Default. Run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=llm-custom-model-input' deepseek/deepseek-flash`, `browser fill 'testid=profile-name-input' QA_inherit`, fill the key as in Create, `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=sdk-settings-llm.temperature'`, `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F10.create-prefill --name inherited-before-save`, Save and `wait-text 'Profile "QA_inherit" created' --timeout 60000`. The saved profile has the temperature the form showed (#18422): `control-openhands api GET /api/profiles/QA_inherit --pick config.temperature` is `0.3`. After `browser reload`, open `QA_inherit`'s row menu (`'[data-testid=profile-row]:has([title="QA_inherit"]) >> testid=profile-menu-trigger'`), click `testid=profile-actions-menu >> testid=profile-edit` and `testid=sdk-section-all-toggle`, `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=sdk-settings-llm.temperature'` and `control-openhands assert --field value --equals 0.3 -- browser value 'testid=sdk-settings-llm.temperature'` passes (screenshot `--feature F10.create-prefill --name edit-after-create`); leave with `testid=cancel-profile-btn`. items.code: - **Name rules (`F13.name-validation`).** In the Add editor, fill `testid=agent-profile-name-input` with `''`, `default`, `'bad name!'` and `QA_ok` in turn; after each run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=agent-profile-name-input' aria-invalid` and `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=save-agent-profile-btn'`. Results: `''` → `true`/`false`; `default` (duplicate) → `true`/`false`; `'bad name!'` → `true`/`false`; `QA_ok` → `false`/`true`. The rule under the field is always shown (grey) and turns the theme danger colour (`text-danger`, #18199) while the name is invalid; it reads `Profile name must start with a letter or digit, and contain only letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens (max 64 characters)`. For the duplicate, `control-openhands browser count 'role=alert >> text=already exists'` is `1`: the alert is the field's description, in the danger colour (`rgb(231, 106, 94)` on OpenHands-Neutral, `rgb(209, 52, 56)` on Light+), while the rule text stays grey. It reads `An agent profile with this name already exists. Choose a different name, or edit the existing one.` (#18411). Take `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F13.name-validation --name duplicate` with `default` filled. In Edit the same message appears for another profile's name and not for the profile's own name (`F13.edit`).

- A taken name marks the field invalid with an alert since #18144 (closed #17938; verified 2026-10-13). Since #18411 (closed #18383; verified 2026-10-14 on desktop and phone) the alert has its own wording, `An agent profile with this name already exists. …`; before it, it reused the Model Router's `A meta-profile with this name already exists. …`. A checkout without #18144 disables Save silently.

Source: `src/routes/secrets-settings.tsx`, `src/components/features/settings/secrets-settings/`, `src/api/secrets-service.ts`, `src/components/features/conversation/secret-request-modal.tsx`, `src/services/secret-request.ts`, `src/stores/secret-request-store.ts`, `src/constants/secret-request.ts`, `src/api/request-secret-client-tool.ts`.

- `F14.agent-request`: in a local conversation the agent's `request_secret` tool opens **The agent needs a secret** over the chat with its reason and the name prefilled; Add secret saves it, attaches it to the running conversation and reports `saved` to the agent, Cancel reports `not_saved`, and a name that is already saved is attached without a dialog. The value never reaches the agent's events.
- The agent itself, in a conversation: its `request_secret` client tool opens the request dialog (`testid=secret-request-modal`) on `/conversations/<id>` (`F14.agent-request`).
- `F14.agent-access`, `F14.rename`, `F14.edit-value` and `F14.agent-request` need an active LLM profile (`control-openhands llm preset deepseek`).
- No secret named `QA_REQ_SECRET` or `QA_REQ_CANCEL` exists, for `F14.agent-request`.

- **Agent requests a secret (`F14.agent-request`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, then `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Call the request_secret tool with name QA_REQ_SECRET and reason 'QA check: a dummy token for verification.' Do not run any other tools. After calling it, end your turn and wait." --wait --timeout 240` (prints `<req-id>`; it leaves the browser on the conversation). `control-openhands conversation events <req-id> --kinds ActionEvent,ObservationEvent` shows the `request_secret` action and the observation `Tool call dispatched to client.`; `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'` reads `dialog "The agent needs a secret"`, the reason `QA check: a dummy token for verification.`, textbox `Name` holding `QA_REQ_SECRET`, `Value`, `Description Optional`, `Cancel` and `Add secret [disabled]` (`browser screenshot --feature F14.agent-request --name modal`). Focus starts in `name-input` and Tab cycles Name, Value, Description and Cancel without leaving the dialog (`control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.dataset.testid"` after each `browser press Tab`). `control-openhands browser press Escape` and `control-openhands browser mouse-click 30 500` leave it open (`browser count 'testid=secret-request-modal'` stays `1`), and so does `control-openhands browser reload`, with the name still prefilled. Run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=secret-request-modal >> testid=value-input' qa-dummy-5190` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=secret-request-modal >> testid=submit-button'`: the dialog closes, `control-openhands api GET /api/settings/secrets` lists `QA_REQ_SECRET`, and after `control-openhands conversation wait <req-id> --fresh --timeout 180` `control-openhands conversation events <req-id> --kinds MessageEvent` holds the user message `[secret-request] {"status":"saved","name":"QA_REQ_SECRET"}`, which the chat does not show (`browser count 'text=[secret-request]'` is `0`). The running conversation now has the value: `control-openhands conversation send <req-id> --prompt "Run exactly this command and reply with only its output: python3 -c \"import os; print(os.environ.get('QA_REQ_SECRET') == 'qa-dummy-5190')\"" --wait --timeout 240`, then the last terminal `ObservationEvent` is `True`. Cancel: `browser goto /`, start a second conversation with the same prompt naming `QA_REQ_CANCEL` and reason `QA cancel check.`, fill `value-input` with `should-not-save` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=secret-request-modal >> testid=cancel-button'`: the dialog closes, `api GET /api/settings/secrets` lists no `QA_REQ_CANCEL`, the agent receives `[secret-request] {"status":"not_saved","name":"QA_REQ_CANCEL","guidance":...}`, and a reload does not bring the dialog back. Already saved: a third conversation asking for `QA_REQ_SECRET` again shows no dialog (`browser count 'testid=secret-request-modal'` `0`) and its events hold `[secret-request] {"status":"saved","name":"QA_REQ_SECRET"}`. Expected: at phone width the dialog fits the viewport (at most 90vw, 351 px at 390 px, `insideViewport` `true`) with the title, every field and both buttons visible. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-14, #18432): at 390×844 `browser bbox 'testid=secret-request-modal'` is 520 px wide at x -65, `insideViewport` `false`, so the title, the field labels and Cancel are cut off on the left (and 65 px on the right); run the block below. Return with `browser viewport desktop`. `QA_REQ_SECRET` is deleted in the cleanup below.

- **Escape cancels delete (`F14.delete-escape`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /settings/secrets`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=secret-item >> has-text=QA_RENAMED_SECRET >> testid=delete-secret-button'`, `control-openhands browser press Escape`, then `control-openhands browser count 'testid=confirmation-modal'` (`0`) and `browser count 'testid=secret-item >> has-text=QA_RENAMED_SECRET'` (`1`). Clean up: delete `QA_RENAMED_SECRET` and then `QA_REQ_SECRET` (from `F14.agent-request`), each with `delete-secret-button` → `testid=confirmation-modal >> testid=confirm-button`, `browser reload`; `api GET /api/settings/secrets` lists only `OPENHANDS_AUTOMATION_API_KEY`.

- Secrets saved in Settings reach only conversations started after the save. Reuse an older conversation and the variable is missing. Only `request_secret` (`F14.agent-request`) attaches a secret to a running conversation, and only on a local backend.

- `request_secret` is registered on every OpenHands-agent conversation this frontend launches since #18408 (not on ACP agents or older conversations) (it appears in Show Agent Tools & Metadata, see `F07.agent-tools-modal`). The agent learns the outcome from a hidden `[secret-request] ...` user message; read it with `conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent`, not from the chat.

items.code: - Switches are `sr-only` checkboxes (keyboard reachable since #18370, which closed #17900): toggle by clicking the label text scoped to the page, read `.checked` with `browser eval`.

- `F16.backend-switch`: switching the active backend in the backend selector while this page is open shows the new backend's stored preferences (the footer already names it), also when switching back to a backend the page has already loaded; an unsaved edit is dropped on switch.

- **Backend switch in place (`F16.backend-switch`).** Needs a second backend with a different Git username: the second stack from F25's Preconditions added as `QA_Second` (F25 Add bullet), arranged with `control-openhands api PATCH /api/settings --run "$OH_VERIFY_RUN_2" --write --data '{"misc_settings_diff":{"app_preferences":{"git_user_name":"QA Second Git"}}}'`. With Local active, run `control-openhands browser goto /settings/app` and `control-openhands browser reload`; `browser value 'testid=git-user-name-input'` is `openhands`. Switch without leaving the page: `control-openhands browser click 'testid=backend-selector'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=backend-selector >> role=option[name="Connected QA_Second"]'`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=environment-switch-overlay' --state detached --timeout 10000`, wait a few seconds: the value is `QA Second Git` and `browser text 'testid=backend-synced-settings-badge'` names QA_Second (a first visit to a backend loads fresh). Switch back the same way to `Connected Local`: the value is `openhands` beside `synced from Local backend`, and it keeps following the active backend on further switches (#18401). The form remounts per backend, so an unsaved edit is dropped: on Local run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=git-user-name-input' 'QA Local Edit'` (`browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` is `true`), switch to `QA_Second` (`QA Second Git`, Save `false`) and back (`openhands`, Save `false`); `control-openhands api GET /api/settings --pick misc_settings.app_preferences.git_user_name` is unchanged. At `browser viewport phone` the selector is in the drawer (`testid=sidebar-mobile-menu-toggle`, then `'testid=sidebar-mobile-drawer >> testid=backend-selector'` and `role=option[name="Connected QA_Second"]`; close the drawer with `browser mouse-click 370 400`) and the field follows the same way. Switch back to Local and remove `QA_Second` afterwards (F25).

- The card toggle and the facet rows are `role=switch`/`role=checkbox` buttons: read `aria-checked`. The modal switch is an `sr-only` checkbox (keyboard reachable since #18370, which closed #17900): click the row text and read `.checked` with `browser eval`.

- `F21.overview-tiles`: four tiles summarize the automations the groups list from the loaded org list (hidden DRAFT test automations from a draft Test are left out): Automations (`N active`), Needs attention (`Latest run failed` or `No latest-run failures`; an enabled automation counts when its latest run is Failed or its task outcome is `failed` or `blocked`, while Partial and Needs review do not count), Total runs and Average duration.

- `F21.saved-drafts`: saved setup drafts (#17242) appear in a **Drafts** group above Active/Inactive, one row each with the name (Resume), a pencil (**Edit**), Play (**Test draft**, tooltip **Test Run**; disabled for event-triggered or non-dispatchable drafts) and a trash (**Delete draft**). Resume and Edit open `/automations/setup?draftId=<id>`; Test dispatches a test run (toast **Test run started.**) on a materialized DRAFT-state automation that the groups do not list; Delete asks **Delete draft?** (`Delete “<name>”? This removes the saved setup draft, but does not delete any final automations.`) with Cancel / **Delete draft** and toasts **Draft deleted.**, also removing the draft's materialized test automation. The confirmation is the named modal dialog **Delete draft?** (the automation delete dialog with draft copy): it opens with focus on Cancel, keeps Tab inside, closes on Escape, X, Cancel or a backdrop click and returns focus to the trash button.

- **Saved drafts (`F21.saved-drafts`, `F21.search`).** Arrange one draft through the setup page (F22's **Open and save a draft**: name `QA_F22 Delta Draft`, prompt `Reply pong. Do not run any tools.`, custom cron `0 0 1 1 *`, Save draft), then `control-openhands browser goto /automations`. `control-openhands browser text 'role=main'` lists `Drafts 1` / `QA_F22 Delta Draft` above the groups, and `control-openhands browser testids 'role=main' --filter draft` lists `automation-setup-draft-<draft-id>`, `-resume-`, `-open-`, `-edit-` (`Edit`), `-test-` (`Test draft`) and `-delete-` (`Delete draft`). `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=automation-setup-draft-test-<draft-id>'` is `Test Run`; clicking it toasts `Test run started.` and the draft (`api GET /api/automation/v1/drafts/<draft-id>`) gains `materialized_automation_id` and `last_test_run_id`; that automation has `state` `DRAFT`, is not listed in any group, and its detail page shows the Draft badge (F23.header). Once its run is `COMPLETED` (poll `api GET '/api/automation/v1/<materialized-id>/runs?limit=10'`), `control-openhands browser reload` leaves the tiles at `Automations 0 / 0 active`, `Total runs 0` and `Average duration —` (`browser text 'testid=overview-tile-total-runs'`): the test automation is not counted. `testid=automation-setup-draft-resume-<draft-id>` and `testid=automation-setup-draft-edit-<draft-id>` each open `/automations/setup?draftId=<draft-id>` (`--expect-url '/automations/setup'`) with the saved values. Search narrows drafts too: filling `Delta` leaves 0 rows and 1 draft; `zzqa-nomatch` shows the filtered empty state with no draft. Delete: click `testid=automation-setup-draft-delete-<draft-id>`; `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog[name="Delete draft?"]'` shows `button "Close"`, heading `Delete draft?`, `Delete “QA_F22 Delta Draft”? This removes the saved setup draft, but does not delete any final automations.`, `Cancel` and `Delete draft`, and `control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.textContent"` is `Cancel`; `browser press Tab` (repeated) cycles Delete draft, Close and Cancel without leaving the dialog. `control-openhands browser press Escape` makes `browser count 'role=dialog[name="Delete draft?"]'` `0` with the draft kept and focus back on `automation-setup-draft-delete-<draft-id>`; reopening and closing with `'role=dialog[name="Delete draft?"] >> role=button[name="Close"]'`, `... role=button[name="Cancel"]` and a backdrop click (`control-openhands browser mouse-click 1400 950`) each give `0` too. At phone width the confirm button is `insideViewport` (`browser bbox 'testid=automation-setup-draft-delete-confirm'`). `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automation-setup-draft-delete-confirm'` toasts `Draft deleted.`; drafts `total` is `0` and the materialized test automation answers `404`.

- **Delete with confirmation (`F21.delete`).** Open Beta's kebab and click `role=list >> has-text=Export >> role=button[name="Delete"]`. `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"]'` shows dialog `Delete automation` with `Close`, the heading, `Delete "QA_F21 Beta"? This cannot be undone.`, `Cancel` and `Delete`; focus starts on Cancel (`control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.textContent"` is `Cancel`) and `browser press Tab` / `Shift+Tab` cycle Cancel, Delete and Close inside the dialog. Take `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F21.delete --name dialog`. `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"] >> role=button[name="Cancel"]'` closes it (`control-openhands browser count 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"]'` is `0`) with the card kept. Reopen and close it with the X (`control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"] >> role=button[name="Close"]'`), then reopen and `control-openhands browser press Escape`: the dialog count is `0` and the card count `1` each time. Reopen, then `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"] >> role=button[name="Delete"]'`, `control-openhands browser reload` and `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^="automation-card-"] >> has-text=QA_F21 Beta'`. The count is `0`. Delete the remaining fixtures the same way (rows work too) until `testid=automations-empty` returns.

- **Agent fills a prompt form (`F22.agent-assisted-setup`, desktop).** Start a fresh form with `control-openhands browser goto /automations`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation-create' --expect-url '/automations/setup'`. Run `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt 'Call automation_form_update exactly once with fields {"name":"QA_F22 DeepSeek Desktop","kind":"prompt","prompt":"Reply pong. Do not run any tools.","frequency":"custom","customSchedule":"0 0 1 1 *","timezone":"UTC","model":"deepseek-flash"}. Do not call any other tools, run terminal commands, inspect files, or read environment variables. Briefly confirm the filled fields and stop.'`. `--stay` sends through the docked composer; omitting it would navigate away to New Chat. The returned `<setup-conversation-id>` opens `/conversations/<id>` with the form beside it. Run `control-openhands conversation wait <setup-conversation-id> --until finished,idle --timeout 60`, then `control-openhands conversation events <setup-conversation-id> --kinds ActionEvent --full`: a genuine `automation_form_update` supplied the exact fields. Read `control-openhands browser value 'testid=automation-setup-name'`, `control-openhands browser value 'testid=automation-setup-prompt'`, `control-openhands browser value 'testid=automation-setup-custom-schedule'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=automation-setup-model'`; they match the requested values. `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=automation-setup-form'` also shows **Filled by OpenHands** markers. Capture `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F22.agent-assisted-setup --name desktop-genuine-tool-filled`; the UI field readbacks and real action establish the update, not the agent's confirmation alone. The sent prompt is not kept as a draft: `control-openhands browser eval "sessionStorage.getItem('oh:home-prompt-draft')"` is `null` (with no earlier Home draft), and the New Chat composer (`browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').innerText"` after clicking `text=New Chat`) and a later `/automations/setup` docked composer are empty; return to `/conversations/<setup-conversation-id>` for the next bullet.

- The setup page's docked composer keeps no draft: it opens empty even when the Home composer has an unsent draft (`sessionStorage` `oh:home-prompt-draft`), a prompt sent from it never becomes the Home draft, and leaving it keeps an existing Home draft. Unsent text typed there is lost when the user leaves the page. Fixed by #18392 (closed #18379); verified 2026-10-14 by a pure UI fill + `submit-button` at desktop and the open-empty check at phone width.
- Dashboard draft Delete asks in the named dialog `role=dialog[name="Delete draft?"]` (F21.saved-drafts). Deleting a draft also removes its materialized test automation.

- `F23.edit-validation`: an empty prompt is refused with the toast **Add a prompt before continuing.** (no request); a bad cron, a cron that never runs or a timeout above 1800 is sent to the API, refused with `422`, and its message is the single error toast (`Value error, Invalid cron expression: not a cron`, `Value error, Cron expression cannot produce any future fire times: 0 0 31 2 *`, `Value error, timeout must not exceed 1800 seconds (30 minutes)`); nothing is saved.

- `F23.edit-time-cleared`: clearing **At** on a preset schedule and saving should be refused with a message instead of being dropped or replaced. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-13, #17948 item, new symptom since #17688): Save silently stores midnight (`0 0 * * 3`) and toasts **Automation updated**; Save draft in the create flow stores `0 0 * * *` the same way. Open PR #18260 (head `0f812ac68902d2c71896568311bffb8aa6f216a6`, checked 2026-10-15) targets the live setup panel: it rejects an invalid or cleared time before Save and Save draft, with an edit-mode regression test. It is not merged; the known failure above remains the observed behavior on this map’s baseline.

- `F23.edit-save-error`: a failed save shows exactly one error toast with the API message (`Automation not found` for an automation deleted meanwhile), the save state reads **Save failed** and the edits stay on the page; the toolbar **Test** on that page also toasts `Automation not found`.

- **Validation (`F23.edit-validation`).** On the edit page run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=automation-setup-prompt' ''`, `control-openhands browser network --clear` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automation-setup-save'`: `control-openhands browser toasts --history` includes the toast `Add a prompt before continuing.` and `browser network --filter 'automation/v1'` lists no request. Refill the prompt. On a Custom-cron automation (QA_F23 Fail) fill `testid=automation-setup-custom-schedule` with `not a cron` (then `0 0 31 2 *`, then a valid cron with `testid=automation-setup-timeout` `1801`), click Save and read `control-openhands browser toasts --history` after `browser toasts --history --clear`. Each sends a `PATCH` that returns `422` (`browser network --filter 'automation/v1'`), and the history holds exactly one toast with the API message: `Value error, Invalid cron expression: not a cron`, `Value error, Cron expression cannot produce any future fire times: 0 0 31 2 *` and `Value error, timeout must not exceed 1800 seconds (30 minutes)`; `api GET /api/automation/v1/<Fail id>` keeps `0 0 1 1 *` and timeout `600`. Before each new click move the pointer off the toast (`browser hover 'testid=automation-setup-name'`, about 5 s; see Gotchas).

- **Cleared time (`F23.edit-time-cleared`).** On the weekly edit page `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=automation-setup-time' ''`, `control-openhands browser network --clear`, click Save. Expected: an inline message and nothing saved. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-13, #17948 item, new symptom since #17688): `browser network --bodies --filter 'automation/v1'` shows a `PATCH` with `schedule` `0 0 * * 3`, the toast reads `Automation updated` and the automation now runs at midnight. Save draft in the create flow (`/automations/setup`) stores `0 0 * * *` the same way; open PR #18260 targets both paths in `automation-setup-panel.tsx` at head `0f812ac68902d2c71896568311bffb8aa6f216a6` (checked 2026-10-15), but is not merged.

- **Run now and save errors (`F23.run-now-error`, `F23.edit-save-error`).** Arrange a stale page: open QA_F23 Fail, then `control-openhands api DELETE /api/automation/v1/<Fail id> --write`. Run `control-openhands browser toasts --history --clear` (empties the toast history), click `role=button[name="Run now"]`, then `control-openhands browser toasts --history` and `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F23.run-now-error --name toasts`: exactly one toast, `Automation not found`, and no `Request failed with status code 404`. Expected: the page then shows **Automation not found**: `control-openhands browser wait 'role=heading[name="QA_F23 Fail"]' --state detached --timeout 15000` succeeds (the not-found state takes about 7 s, as in States) and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=paragraph >> text=Automation not found >> xpath=..'` lists link `Back to Automations` (do not use `wait-text 'Automation not found'` here: the toast has the same text). Once the heading is gone, run `control-openhands browser toasts --history` again: it still holds only `Automation not found` (a late second toast, `Request failed with status code 404`, would come from the page's own refetch of the deleted automation). Known failure: the wait times out and the page keeps heading `QA_F23 Fail`, `Active` and an enabled **Run now** (`control-openhands browser enabled 'role=button[name="Run now"]'` is `true`) until a reload (#18062). The save error does not reuse that page (it is gone once #18062 is fixed): arrange a second fixture, `control-openhands api POST /api/automation/v1/preset/prompt --write --data '{"name":"QA_F23 Stale","prompt":"Reply with the single word: pong.","trigger":{"type":"cron","schedule":"0 0 1 1 *","timezone":"UTC"},"enabled":false}'` (`body.id` is `<stale-id>`), open QA_F23 Stale, its kebab and `role=list >> has-text=Tarball >> role=button[name="Edit"]` (`--expect-url '/automations/setup'`). With the edit page open, `control-openhands api DELETE /api/automation/v1/<stale-id> --write` and `control-openhands browser toasts --history --clear`. Fill `testid=automation-setup-name` with `QA_F23 Stale renamed` and click `testid=automation-setup-save`: the page keeps the edit (`browser value 'testid=automation-setup-name'` still `QA_F23 Stale renamed`) and `browser toasts --history` holds exactly one toast, `Automation not found`. One Canvas can drive several agent servers. The backend selector at the bottom
of the sidebar lists every registered backend with a live status dot and
switches between them; its footer opens **Add Backend** (OpenHands Cloud login
through an OAuth device flow, or a local/remote agent server by host and API
key) and **Manage Backends** (select, edit, remove, and Cloud "Log back in").
When the active backend is unreachable the whole app is replaced by Manage
backends in recovery mode. Cloud backends add organization rows, a Cloud
settings link and public sharing of conversations (read-only at
`/shared/conversations/:id`); `/oauth/device/verify` is the device-approval page.
When the page is served with the DigitalOcean Managed Agents bridge (the
desktop app's preload, or the web server's own bridge, which the launcher's
ingress mounts by default behind the session key since #18349), Add Backend gains a
**Providers** tab whose DigitalOcean entry signs in with a personal access
token and turns a Managed Agents session into a backend.
Everything except the Cloud and DigitalOcean accounts themselves can be driven
locally with a second `control-openhands` stack as the extra backend.

items.code: - **Desktop splash and window (`F26.desktop-boot-splash`, `F26.desktop-main-window`).** Start a private display and the app in one process group: `Q=$OH_VERIFY_RUN/private/f26-desktop; mkdir -p $Q/shots; setsid nohup sh -c "echo \$\$ > $Q/pgid; Xvfb :78 -screen 0 1440x1000x24 -nolisten tcp & sleep 1; DISPLAY=:78 HOME=$Q/home OH_CANVAS_SAFE_STATE_DIR=$Q/state LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY=qa-f26-desktop-key OH_SECRET_KEY=qa-f26-secret DO_NOT_TRACK=1 exec node_modules/.bin/electron --no-sandbox electron" > $Q/desktop.log 2>&1 &`, then capture frames: `for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; DISPLAY=:78 import -window root $Q/shots/s$(printf %02d $i).png; done`. Read the frames: the first seconds show the splash (logo, `OpenHands Agent Canvas`, `AI coding agent interface`, spinner, `Starting backend services…`, then lines such as `agent-server: {"asctime": ...`, the note `First launch downloads Python + the OpenHands agent server.` and a **Show details** button); a later frame shows the main window with a `File Edit View Window` menu and the first-run **Choose your agent** step under the consent dialog naming `the local backend "Local" at http://localhost:8000` (about 30 s on a warm cache, minutes on the first download). While it runs, `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/mars/health | head -c 15` prints `<!DOCTYPE html>`: the desktop stack's ingress hosts no bridge (`marsWebBridge: false`, `F26.mars-web-bridge`). Copy the frames you cite into `$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/F26.desktop-boot-splash/` and `.../F26.desktop-main-window/`. Stop in two steps: `kill -TERM $(cat $Q/pgid)` signals only the Electron launcher (it quits and stops its backend services); after about 10 s ports 8000, 18000, 18001 and 3001 are free again. Then `kill -TERM -- -$(cat $Q/pgid)` ends Xvfb; `ps -o pid,cmd -g $(cat $Q/pgid)` lists nothing.

items.code: - `F02.checklist-dismiss`: hovering or focusing the card (expanded or minimized) reveals an X (`Dismiss checklist`) in its header; touch devices always show it. Clicking it hides the card for good (it stays hidden after a reload) and turns off the **Show Getting Started checklist** switch in Settings → Application, which brings the card back in its previous expanded or minimized state (#18185).
- The **Getting started** card: click an item row to go to its page, or hover it for the preview; hover the card for the X that dismisses it.

- **Dismiss (`F02.checklist-dismiss`).** On `/conversations`, `control-openhands browser count 'role=button[name="Dismiss checklist"]'` is `0` (the X is `opacity-0` and `invisible` until the card is hovered). Run `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=command-menu-trigger'`, `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=sidebar-onboarding-checklist-toggle'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'role=button[name="Dismiss checklist"]' --state visible --timeout 5000` (`browser screenshot 'aside[data-collapsed]' --feature F02.checklist-dismiss --name hover-close`). Run `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Dismiss checklist"]'`: `browser count 'testid=sidebar-onboarding-checklist'` is `0`, still `0` after `control-openhands browser reload`, and `browser storage` lists `openhands-sidebar-onboarding-checklist-dismissed`. On `/settings/app`, `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=show-getting-started-checklist-switch]').checked"` is `false`; `control-openhands browser click 'text=Show Getting Started checklist'` brings the card back. Minimized: `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sidebar-onboarding-checklist-toggle'` (`data-minimized` `true`), hover as above, click the X (count `0`), click the switch text again: the card returns with `data-minimized` `true`; click the toggle to expand it. At phone width the X shows in the drawer's card the same way.

- **Error toast (`F02.error-toasts`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001` and `control-openhands browser wait-text 'This conversation does not exist'`. The URL becomes `/conversations`, and `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F02.error-toasts --name missing-conversation` shows a top-right error toast. It is the only toast: `control-openhands browser toasts` lists just the "This conversation does not exist, or you do not have permission to access it…" text, and `control-openhands browser toasts --history` has no entry containing `this UI does not understand`. `control-openhands browser wait 'text=This conversation does not exist' --state hidden` passes within 30 s. Light theme: arrange `control-openhands browser eval "localStorage.setItem('openhands-color-theme','light-plus')"`, repeat the `goto`, and read `control-openhands browser eval "(()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=status]')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('does not exist'));return getComputedStyle(t).color+' on '+getComputedStyle(t.closest('div[style]')).backgroundColor})()"`: `rgb(31, 31, 31) on rgb(229, 229, 229)`: every toast uses the theme's high-emphasis ink (`--oh-contrast`) on its surface (#18387, fixed by #18403; the error toast is no longer muted, so the default theme reads `rgb(255, 255, 255) on rgb(49, 49, 49)`). A success toast reads the same: save any change on `/settings/app` (for example `control-openhands browser click 'testid=app-settings-screen >> text=Sound Notifications'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button'`, then toggle it back and save again) and read the `Settings saved` toast the same way: `rgb(31, 31, 31) on rgb(229, 229, 229)`. Solarized Light (`solarized-light`) gives `rgb(0, 43, 54) on rgb(230, 223, 204)` for both toasts. Restore with `browser eval "localStorage.removeItem('openhands-color-theme')"`.

- Dismissing the checklist with its X and the App settings switch write the same browser-local flag, so either one undoes the other. Clicking **Join the OpenHands Slack** counts as joining and opens an external tab you must close.

Do not run any tools.' --wait --timeout 180` (one tiny model call; note `<setup-id>`). `control-openhands api GET /api/conversations/<setup-id> --pick tags` has `automationsetup: draft`. In the sidebar, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Reply >> testid=conversation-card-tag-chip'` is `Automation setup: Draft` (the first chip; the internal draft-id keys stay hidden). Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=tag-filters-section'`: the facet `testid=tag-facet-row-automationsetup=draft` reads `Automation setup: Draft`; click it, `control-openhands browser press Escape`, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-active-tag-filters'` is `Automation setup: Draft` and `Clear all`, with only setup conversations (and pinned rows) left; `control-openhands browser click 'testid=active-tag-filter-automationsetup=draft'` removes it. After `control-openhands browser mouse-click 900 900`, `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Reply'` lists `Automation setup` and the raw value `draft` (`browser screenshot --feature F04.automation-setup-tag --name facet`). End with `control-openhands browser goto /`; since #18392 the setup send leaves no Home draft, and since #18385 opening another conversation from the sidebar leaves that conversation's tags alone (see Gotchas).

- Opening a conversation from the sidebar never changes its tags, also right after an automation setup conversation (one tagged `automationsetup: draft`): the other conversation keeps its tags and opens as a normal chat (#18378, fixed by #18385; recipe in F07 `F07.open-by-url`). - **Home draft (`F05.draft-persistence`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'QA home draft'`, `control-openhands browser goto /settings/secrets`, `control-openhands browser goto /`, then the `innerText` eval: `QA home draft`; `control-openhands browser storage --session` lists `oh:home-prompt-draft`. The automation setup page's docked composer (`/automations/setup`, F22) keeps no draft and never touches the Home one (#18379, fixed by #18392). With `QA home draft` still in the Home composer, run `control-openhands browser goto /automations`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation-create' --expect-url '/automations/setup'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-input'`: the `innerText` eval is empty. `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only the word ok2. Do not run any tools.'`, then `control-openhands browser eval "new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(sessionStorage.getItem('oh:home-prompt-draft')),1500))"` still returns `QA home draft`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sidebar-conversations-link' --expect-url '/conversations(\?|$)'`: the Home composer shows `QA home draft`. Unsent text in the setup composer is lost when the user leaves that page (by design, #18392).

- **Attach a file and an image (`F05.attach-files`).** On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser upload 'testid=upload-image-input' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-image.png" "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt"` and `control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box' --feature F05.attach-files --name attached`: a `qa-note.txt TXT` chip and a thumbnail. `control-openhands browser count 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> alt=qa-image.png'` is `1`. `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Upload as file"]'` turns the image toggle into `Do not upload as file` (`control-openhands browser attr 'role=button[name="Do not upload as file"]' aria-pressed` is `true`); click it again to restore. The remove buttons are named: `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` lists `button "Remove qa-note.txt"` and `button "Remove image"`. Remove the image with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> role=button[name="Remove image"]'`; the `alt=qa-image.png` count is `0`. Then `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only the content of the attached file.'`, `control-openhands browser press Enter --selector 'testid=chat-input'`, wait as in Type and send, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=user-message >> nth=-1'`: it ends `NEW FILES ADDED: qa-note.txt`. `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent --last 3` shows the reply `QA attachment 7731`, and `qa-note.txt` sits in the conversation `workspace` printed by `control-openhands conversation status <id>`. Attachments added on Home before the conversation exists upload after it is created: with no workspace or a Local Repo workspace they land in it (`browser network --filter upload` shows `200`). Expected: the same in New Worktree mode. The same file attached inside that conversation afterwards uploads to the worktree (`200`). Restore with `testid=workspace-mode-selector-option-local_repo`.

- `F06.confirmation-mode`: with confirmation mode on, a lock chip sits above the composer and each action waits for "Do you want to continue with this action?" with Cancel and Continue (hints `⇧⌘⌫` / `⌘↩` on macOS, `Ctrl+⇧+⌫` / `Ctrl+↩` elsewhere, hidden below 640 px); a cancelled action is marked Rejected and counts as resolved in its group.

- **Long table cell (`F06.markdown-rendering`).** On the stream conversation write a prompt file whose first line is `Reply with only the word OK. Do not run any tools.`, then a blank line and the table `| Name | Description | Status |`, `|---|---|---|`, `| Alpha | This is a really long sentence in a single cell that goes on and on to explain a very involved aspect of the system, which nobody could read on one line without scrolling forever to the right. | ok |`, `| Beta | brief | fail |`. Run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' x --value-file <file>`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button'` and `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --fresh --timeout 120`; the user bubble renders the table. - **Confirmation mode on (`F06.confirmation-mode`).** Arrange through the settings UI, in this order (the Security Analyzer field appears only once Confirmation Mode is on): `control-openhands browser goto /settings/verification`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> text=Confirmation Mode'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sdk-section-all-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> role=button[name="Show suggestions"]'`, `control-openhands browser click 'role=listbox >> role=option[name="None"]'`, `control-openhands browser value 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> role=combobox[name="Security Analyzer"]'` (`None`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> testid=save-button'`; `control-openhands api GET /api/settings` shows `"confirmation_mode": true` and `"security_analyzer": "none"` (None means every action is confirmed; the default LLM analyzer only stops HIGH-risk actions, so `echo` would run unprompted). Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run the terminal command 'echo qa-confirm-ok' and reply with its output." --wait --timeout 180`: it returns `"status": "waiting_for_confirmation"`. `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` ends `Do you want to continue with this action? Cancel Ctrl+⇧+⌫ Continue Ctrl+↩` on Linux (`Cancel ⇧⌘⌫ Continue ⌘↩` on macOS, #18127), `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=action-confirm-button'` is `Confirm the requested action`, and a lock icon sits above the composer (screenshot). The tooltip stays open over the Cancel button, so move the pointer first: `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=chat-input'`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=action-reject-button'`: status `idle`, the buttons are gone, `conversation events <id> --last 6` ends with `UserRejectObservation`, and the action's row reads `Rejected` (`control-openhands browser count 'testid=rejected-indicator'` is `1`) with no spinner. Then reply DONE.`, continue the first action (`browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button'`, then `control-openhands browser press Control+Enter`, which is also the next bullet's shortcut) and cancel the second (`browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button' --timeout 60000`, `control-openhands browser press Control+Shift+Backspace`): status `idle`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1'` ends `2 actions completed`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1 >> .animate-spin'` is `0`, the same after `browser reload`, and the expanded group (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1 >> button >> nth=0'`) shows `Rejected` on the `qa-g2` row (`browser screenshot 'testid=chat-interface' --feature F06.confirmation-mode --name group-after-reload`). - `F14.agent-request`: in a local conversation the agent's `request_secret` tool opens **The agent needs a secret** over the chat with its reason and the name prefilled; Add secret saves it, attaches it to the running conversation and reports `saved` to the agent, Cancel reports `not_saved`, and a name that is already saved is attached without a dialog. The value never reaches the agent's events.
- The agent itself, in a conversation: its `request_secret` client tool opens the request dialog (`testid=secret-request-modal`) on `/conversations/<id>` (`F14.agent-request`).
- `F14.agent-access`, `F14.rename`, `F14.edit-value` and `F14.agent-request` need an active LLM profile (`control-openhands llm preset deepseek`).
- No secret named `QA_REQ_SECRET` or `QA_REQ_CANCEL` exists, for `F14.agent-request`.

- **Agent requests a secret (`F14.agent-request`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, then `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Call the request_secret tool with name QA_REQ_SECRET and reason 'QA check: a dummy token for verification.' Do not run any other tools. After calling it, end your turn and wait." --wait --timeout 240` (prints `<req-id>`; it leaves the browser on the conversation). `control-openhands conversation events <req-id> --kinds ActionEvent,ObservationEvent` shows the `request_secret` action and the observation `Tool call dispatched to client.`; `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'` reads `dialog "The agent needs a secret"`, the reason `QA check: a dummy token for verification.`, textbox `Name` holding `QA_REQ_SECRET`, `Value`, `Description Optional`, `Cancel` and `Add secret [disabled]` (`browser screenshot --feature F14.agent-request --name modal`). Focus starts in `name-input` and Tab cycles Name, Value, Description and Cancel without leaving the dialog (`control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.dataset.testid"` after each `browser press Tab`). `control-openhands browser press Escape` and `control-openhands browser mouse-click 30 500` leave it open (`browser count 'testid=secret-request-modal'` stays `1`), and so does `control-openhands browser reload`, with the name still prefilled. Run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=secret-request-modal >> testid=value-input' qa-dummy-5190` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=secret-request-modal >> testid=submit-button'`: the dialog closes, `control-openhands api GET /api/settings/secrets` lists `QA_REQ_SECRET`, and after `control-openhands conversation wait <req-id> --fresh --timeout 180` `control-openhands conversation events <req-id> --kinds MessageEvent` holds the user message `[secret-request] {"status":"saved","name":"QA_REQ_SECRET"}`, which the chat does not show (`browser count 'text=[secret-request]'` is `0`). The running conversation now has the value: `control-openhands conversation send <req-id> --prompt "Run exactly this command and reply with only its output: python3 -c \"import os; print(os.environ.get('QA_REQ_SECRET') == 'qa-dummy-5190')\"" --wait --timeout 240`, then the last terminal `ObservationEvent` is `True`. Cancel: `browser goto /`, start a second conversation with the same prompt naming `QA_REQ_CANCEL` and reason `QA cancel check.`, fill `value-input` with `should-not-save` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=secret-request-modal >> testid=cancel-button'`: the dialog closes, `api GET /api/settings/secrets` lists no `QA_REQ_CANCEL`, the agent receives `[secret-request] {"status":"not_saved","name":"QA_REQ_CANCEL","guidance":...}`, and a reload does not bring the dialog back. Already saved: a third conversation asking for `QA_REQ_SECRET` again shows no dialog (`browser count 'testid=secret-request-modal'` `0`) and its events hold `[secret-request] {"status":"saved","name":"QA_REQ_SECRET"}`. Expected: at phone width the dialog fits the viewport (at most 90vw, 351 px at 390 px, `insideViewport` `true`) with the title, every field and both buttons visible. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-14, #18432): at 390×844 `browser bbox 'testid=secret-request-modal'` is 520 px wide at x -65, `insideViewport` `false`, so the title, the field labels and Cancel are cut off on the left (and 65 px on the right); run the block below. Return with `browser viewport desktop`. `QA_REQ_SECRET` is deleted in the cleanup below.

- **Escape cancels delete (`F14.delete-escape`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /settings/secrets`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=secret-item >> has-text=QA_RENAMED_SECRET >> testid=delete-secret-button'`, `control-openhands browser press Escape`, then `control-openhands browser count 'testid=confirmation-modal'` (`0`) and `browser count 'testid=secret-item >> has-text=QA_RENAMED_SECRET'` (`1`). Clean up: delete `QA_RENAMED_SECRET` and then `QA_REQ_SECRET` (from `F14.agent-request`), each with `delete-secret-button` → `testid=confirmation-modal >> testid=confirm-button`, `browser reload`; `api GET /api/settings/secrets` lists only `OPENHANDS_AUTOMATION_API_KEY`.

- Secrets saved in Settings reach only conversations started after the save. Reuse an older conversation and the variable is missing. Only `request_secret` (`F14.agent-request`) attaches a secret to a running conversation, and only on a local backend.

- `request_secret` is registered on every OpenHands-agent conversation this frontend launches since #18408 (not on ACP agents or older conversations) (it appears in Show Agent Tools & Metadata, see `F07.agent-tools-modal`). The agent learns the outcome from a hidden `[secret-request] ...` user message; read it with `conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent`, not from the chat.
