At `browser viewport phone` the selector is in the drawer (`testid=sidebar-mobile-menu-toggle`, then `'testid=sidebar-mobile-drawer >> testid=backend-selector'` and `role=option[name="Connected QA_Second"]`; close the drawer with `browser mouse-click 370 400`) and the field follows the same way. Switch back to Local and remove `QA_Second` afterwards (F25).

- The card toggle and the facet rows are `role=switch`/`role=checkbox` buttons: read `aria-checked`. The modal switch is an `sr-only` checkbox (keyboard reachable since #18370, which closed #17900): click the row text and read `.checked` with `browser eval`.

- `F21.overview-tiles`: four tiles summarize the automations the groups list from the loaded org list (hidden DRAFT test automations from a draft Test are left out): Automations (`N active`), Needs attention (`Latest run failed` or `No latest-run failures`; an enabled automation counts when its latest run is Failed or its task outcome is `failed` or `blocked`, while Partial and Needs review do not count), Total runs and Average duration.

- `F21.saved-drafts`: saved setup drafts (#17242) appear in a **Drafts** group above Active/Inactive, one row each with the name (Resume), a pencil (**Edit**), Play (**Test draft**, tooltip **Test Run**; disabled for event-triggered or non-dispatchable drafts) and a trash (**Delete draft**). Resume and Edit open `/automations/setup?draftId=<id>`; Test dispatches a test run (toast **Test run started.**) on a materialized DRAFT-state automation that the groups do not list; Delete asks **Delete draft?** (`Delete “<name>”? This removes the saved setup draft, but does not delete any final automations.`) with Cancel / **Delete draft** and toasts **Draft deleted.**, also removing the draft's materialized test automation. The confirmation is the named modal dialog **Delete draft?** (the automation delete dialog with draft copy): it opens with focus on Cancel, keeps Tab inside, closes on Escape, X, Cancel or a backdrop click and returns focus to the trash button.

- **Saved drafts (`F21.saved-drafts`, `F21.search`).** Arrange one draft through the setup page (F22's **Open and save a draft**: name `QA_F22 Delta Draft`, prompt `Reply pong. Do not run any tools.`, custom cron `0 0 1 1 *`, Save draft), then `control-openhands browser goto /automations`. `control-openhands browser text 'role=main'` lists `Drafts 1` / `QA_F22 Delta Draft` above the groups, and `control-openhands browser testids 'role=main' --filter draft` lists `automation-setup-draft-<draft-id>`, `-resume-`, `-open-`, `-edit-` (`Edit`), `-test-` (`Test draft`) and `-delete-` (`Delete draft`). `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=automation-setup-draft-test-<draft-id>'` is `Test Run`; clicking it toasts `Test run started.` and the draft (`api GET /api/automation/v1/drafts/<draft-id>`) gains `materialized_automation_id` and `last_test_run_id`; that automation has `state` `DRAFT`, is not listed in any group, and its detail page shows the Draft badge (F23.header). Once its run is `COMPLETED` (poll `api GET '/api/automation/v1/<materialized-id>/runs?limit=10'`), `control-openhands browser reload` leaves the tiles at `Automations 0 / 0 active`, `Total runs 0` and `Average duration —` (`browser text 'testid=overview-tile-total-runs'`): the test automation is not counted. `testid=automation-setup-draft-resume-<draft-id>` and `testid=automation-setup-draft-edit-<draft-id>` each open `/automations/setup?draftId=<draft-id>` (`--expect-url '/automations/setup'`) with the saved values. Search narrows drafts too: filling `Delta` leaves 0 rows and 1 draft; `zzqa-nomatch` shows the filtered empty state with no draft. Delete: click `testid=automation-setup-draft-delete-<draft-id>`; `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog[name="Delete draft?"]'` shows `button "Close"`, heading `Delete draft?`, `Delete “QA_F22 Delta Draft”? This removes the saved setup draft, but does not delete any final automations.`, `Cancel` and `Delete draft`, and `control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.textContent"` is `Cancel`; `browser press Tab` (repeated) cycles Delete draft, Close and Cancel without leaving the dialog. `control-openhands browser press Escape` makes `browser count 'role=dialog[name="Delete draft?"]'` `0` with the draft kept and focus back on `automation-setup-draft-delete-<draft-id>`; reopening and closing with `'role=dialog[name="Delete draft?"] >> role=button[name="Close"]'`, `... role=button[name="Cancel"]` and a backdrop click (`control-openhands browser mouse-click 1400 950`) each give `0` too. At phone width the confirm button is `insideViewport` (`browser bbox 'testid=automation-setup-draft-delete-confirm'`). `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automation-setup-draft-delete-confirm'` toasts `Draft deleted.`; drafts `total` is `0` and the materialized test automation answers `404`.

- **Delete with confirmation (`F21.delete`).** Open Beta's kebab and click `role=list >> has-text=Export >> role=button[name="Delete"]`. `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"]'` shows dialog `Delete automation` with `Close`, the heading, `Delete "QA_F21 Beta"? This cannot be undone.`, `Cancel` and `Delete`; focus starts on Cancel (`control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.textContent"` is `Cancel`) and `browser press Tab` / `Shift+Tab` cycle Cancel, Delete and Close inside the dialog. Take `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F21.delete --name dialog`. `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"] >> role=button[name="Cancel"]'` closes it (`control-openhands browser count 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"]'` is `0`) with the card kept. Reopen and close it with the X (`control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"] >> role=button[name="Close"]'`), then reopen and `control-openhands browser press Escape`: the dialog count is `0` and the card count `1` each time. Reopen, then `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog[name="Delete automation"] >> role=button[name="Delete"]'`, `control-openhands browser reload` and `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^="automation-card-"] >> has-text=QA_F21 Beta'`. The count is `0`. Delete the remaining fixtures the same way (rows work too) until `testid=automations-empty` returns.

- **Agent fills a prompt form (`F22.agent-assisted-setup`, desktop).** Start a fresh form with `control-openhands browser goto /automations`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation-create' --expect-url '/automations/setup'`. Run `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt 'Call automation_form_update exactly once with fields {"name":"QA_F22 DeepSeek Desktop","kind":"prompt","prompt":"Reply pong. Do not run any tools.","frequency":"custom","customSchedule":"0 0 1 1 *","timezone":"UTC","model":"deepseek-flash"}. Do not call any other tools, run terminal commands, inspect files, or read environment variables. Briefly confirm the filled fields and stop.'`. `--stay` sends through the docked composer; omitting it would navigate away to New Chat. The returned `<setup-conversation-id>` opens `/conversations/<id>` with the form beside it. Run `control-openhands conversation wait <setup-conversation-id> --until finished,idle --timeout 60`, then `control-openhands conversation events <setup-conversation-id> --kinds ActionEvent --full`: a genuine `automation_form_update` supplied the exact fields. Read `control-openhands browser value 'testid=automation-setup-name'`, `control-openhands browser value 'testid=automation-setup-prompt'`, `control-openhands browser value 'testid=automation-setup-custom-schedule'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=automation-setup-model'`; they match the requested values. `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=automation-setup-form'` also shows **Filled by OpenHands** markers. Capture `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F22.agent-assisted-setup --name desktop-genuine-tool-filled`; the UI field readbacks and real action establish the update, not the agent's confirmation alone. The sent prompt is not kept as a draft: `control-openhands browser eval "sessionStorage.getItem('oh:home-prompt-draft')"` is `null` (with no earlier Home draft), and the New Chat composer (`browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').innerText"` after clicking `text=New Chat`) and a later `/automations/setup` docked composer are empty; return to `/conversations/<setup-conversation-id>` for the next bullet.

- The setup page's docked composer keeps no draft: it opens empty even when the Home composer has an unsent draft (`sessionStorage` `oh:home-prompt-draft`), a prompt sent from it never becomes the Home draft, and leaving it keeps an existing Home draft. Unsent text typed there is lost when the user leaves the page. Fixed by #18392 (closed #18379); verified 2026-10-14 by a pure UI fill + `submit-button` at desktop and the open-empty check at phone width.
- Dashboard draft Delete asks in the named dialog `role=dialog[name="Delete draft?"]` (F21.saved-drafts). Deleting a draft also removes its materialized test automation.

- `F23.edit-validation`: an empty prompt is refused with the toast **Add a prompt before continuing.** (no request); a bad cron, a cron that never runs or a timeout above 1800 is sent to the API, refused with `422`, and its message is the single error toast (`Value error, Invalid cron expression: not a cron`, `Value error, Cron expression cannot produce any future fire times: 0 0 31 2 *`, `Value error, timeout must not exceed 1800 seconds (30 minutes)`); nothing is saved.

An unresolved known defect, its reproduction and issue reference are allowed. Current prerequisites, supported backend/version differences, source references and executable baseline/fix proof commands are allowed; a PR number alone is not a violation.

items.code: - `F23.edit-time-cleared`: clearing **At** on a preset schedule and saving should be refused with a message instead of being dropped or replaced. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-13, #17948 item, new symptom since #17688): Save silently stores midnight (`0 0 * * 3`) and toasts **Automation updated**; Save draft in the create flow stores `0 0 * * *` the same way. Open PR #18260 (head `0f812ac68902d2c71896568311bffb8aa6f216a6`, checked 2026-10-15) targets the live setup panel: it rejects an invalid or cleared time before Save and Save draft, with an edit-mode regression test. It is not merged; the known failure above remains the observed behavior on this map’s baseline.

- `F23.edit-save-error`: a failed save shows exactly one error toast with the API message (`Automation not found` for an automation deleted meanwhile), the save state reads **Save failed** and the edits stay on the page; the toolbar **Test** on that page also toasts `Automation not found`.

- **Validation (`F23.edit-validation`).** On the edit page run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=automation-setup-prompt' ''`, `control-openhands browser network --clear` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automation-setup-save'`: `control-openhands browser toasts --history` includes the toast `Add a prompt before continuing.` and `browser network --filter 'automation/v1'` lists no request. Refill the prompt. On a Custom-cron automation (QA_F23 Fail) fill `testid=automation-setup-custom-schedule` with `not a cron` (then `0 0 31 2 *`, then a valid cron with `testid=automation-setup-timeout` `1801`), click Save and read `control-openhands browser toasts --history` after `browser toasts --history --clear`. Each sends a `PATCH` that returns `422` (`browser network --filter 'automation/v1'`), and the history holds exactly one toast with the API message: `Value error, Invalid cron expression: not a cron`, `Value error, Cron expression cannot produce any future fire times: 0 0 31 2 *` and `Value error, timeout must not exceed 1800 seconds (30 minutes)`; `api GET /api/automation/v1/<Fail id>` keeps `0 0 1 1 *` and timeout `600`. Before each new click move the pointer off the toast (`browser hover 'testid=automation-setup-name'`, about 5 s; see Gotchas).

- **Cleared time (`F23.edit-time-cleared`).** On the weekly edit page `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=automation-setup-time' ''`, `control-openhands browser network --clear`, click Save. Expected: an inline message and nothing saved. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-13, #17948 item, new symptom since #17688): `browser network --bodies --filter 'automation/v1'` shows a `PATCH` with `schedule` `0 0 * * 3`, the toast reads `Automation updated` and the automation now runs at midnight. Save draft in the create flow (`/automations/setup`) stores `0 0 * * *` the same way; open PR #18260 targets both paths in `automation-setup-panel.tsx` at head `0f812ac68902d2c71896568311bffb8aa6f216a6` (checked 2026-10-15), but is not merged.

- **Run now and save errors (`F23.run-now-error`, `F23.edit-save-error`).** Arrange a stale page: open QA_F23 Fail, then `control-openhands api DELETE /api/automation/v1/<Fail id> --write`. Run `control-openhands browser toasts --history --clear` (empties the toast history), click `role=button[name="Run now"]`, then `control-openhands browser toasts --history` and `control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F23.run-now-error --name toasts`: exactly one toast, `Automation not found`, and no `Request failed with status code 404`. Expected: the page then shows **Automation not found**: `control-openhands browser wait 'role=heading[name="QA_F23 Fail"]' --state detached --timeout 15000` succeeds (the not-found state takes about 7 s, as in States) and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=paragraph >> text=Automation not found >> xpath=..'` lists link `Back to Automations` (do not use `wait-text 'Automation not found'` here: the toast has the same text). Once the heading is gone, run `control-openhands browser toasts --history` again: it still holds only `Automation not found` (a late second toast, `Request failed with status code 404`, would come from the page's own refetch of the deleted automation). Known failure: the wait times out and the page keeps heading `QA_F23 Fail`, `Active` and an enabled **Run now** (`control-openhands browser enabled 'role=button[name="Run now"]'` is `true`) until a reload (#18062). The save error does not reuse that page (it is gone once #18062 is fixed): arrange a second fixture, `control-openhands api POST /api/automation/v1/preset/prompt --write --data '{"name":"QA_F23 Stale","prompt":"Reply with the single word: pong.","trigger":{"type":"cron","schedule":"0 0 1 1 *","timezone":"UTC"},"enabled":false}'` (`body.id` is `<stale-id>`), open QA_F23 Stale, its kebab and `role=list >> has-text=Tarball >> role=button[name="Edit"]` (`--expect-url '/automations/setup'`). With the edit page open, `control-openhands api DELETE /api/automation/v1/<stale-id> --write` and `control-openhands browser toasts --history --clear`. Fill `testid=automation-setup-name` with `QA_F23 Stale renamed` and click `testid=automation-setup-save`: the page keeps the edit (`browser value 'testid=automation-setup-name'` still `QA_F23 Stale renamed`) and `browser toasts --history` holds exactly one toast, `Automation not found`. Screenshot with `--feature F23.edit-save-error --name toast`. Move the pointer off the toast (`browser hover 'testid=automation-setup-name'`, about 5 s), `browser toasts --history --clear` and click `testid=automation-setup-test`: again exactly one toast, `Automation not found`. Close. `browser errors --app-only` lists the induced `POST /api/automation/v1/<Fail id>/dispatch`, `PATCH /api/automation/v1/<stale-id>` and `POST /api/automation/v1/<stale-id>/dispatch` 404s; both fixtures are already deleted.

- Since #17688 kebab **Edit** (detail and dashboard) opens `/automations/setup?automationId=<id>`; the old **Edit automation** modal (`edit-automation-*` test ids) was deleted as dead code by #18417, so its Escape (#17563), phone clipping (#17563) and silently-ignored cleared time (#17948) symptoms cannot be reached. The edit page's Save and Test report API failures with the API's message (see `F23.edit-validation`, `F23.edit-save-error`), and its `Automation updated` toast covers Test/Save/Close until the pointer moves away.

One Canvas can drive several agent servers. The backend selector at the bottom
of the sidebar lists every registered backend with a live status dot and
switches between them; its footer opens **Add Backend** (OpenHands Cloud login
through an OAuth device flow, or a local/remote agent server by host and API
key) and **Manage Backends** (select, edit, remove, and Cloud "Log back in").
When the active backend is unreachable the whole app is replaced by Manage
backends in recovery mode. Cloud backends add organization rows, a Cloud
settings link and public sharing of conversations (read-only at
`/shared/conversations/:id`); `/oauth/device/verify` is the device-approval page.
When the page is served with the DigitalOcean Managed Agents bridge (the
desktop app's preload, or the web server's own bridge, which the launcher's
ingress mounts by default behind the session key since #18349), Add Backend gains a
**Providers** tab whose DigitalOcean entry signs in with a personal access
token and turns a Managed Agents session into a backend.
Everything except the Cloud and DigitalOcean accounts themselves can be driven
locally with a second `control-openhands` stack as the extra backend.

- `F25.add-backend-modal`: **Add Backend** opens "Choose how you want to connect" with a description, a **Learn more** link to the deployment docs and the tabs **OpenHands Cloud** (selected) and **Agent-server** (plus **Providers** with the bridge, see the Providers row). It takes keyboard focus on open (the close button), Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside it, and at desktop width closing returns focus to the backend selector (at phone width the drawer closes with the modal and focus falls back to the page body). Escape does not close it; the X does.

- `F25.manage-backends`: Manage backends lists every backend with status dot, name, version (`v1.50.1`), host, status text and a LOCAL/CLOUD pill, plus Edit and Remove; it takes keyboard focus on open and keeps Tab inside; Escape, a backdrop click, X and **Done** close it and return focus to the selector.

- `F25.providers-tab`: only when the page has the Managed Agents bridge (`window.marsBridge`), Add Backend shows a third tab **Providers** ("Connect through DigitalOcean and more.") with a **DigitalOcean** card ("Your team's OpenHands agents") and `More providers coming soon.`. Since #18349 every launcher-served web page has it (the ingress answers `/mars/health`); without it (`MARS_WEB=0`, or a non-loopback bind with no session key at all) there are only the Cloud and Agent-server tabs and no Managed Agents UI anywhere. A non-loopback bind that has a key (F26 `--host 0.0.0.0` with `LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY`) mounts the bridge behind that key and offers the tab too, although the page itself carries no key (see the sign-in bullet's Known failure).

- The Managed Agents rows need the bridge, which every `control-openhands launch` run has since #18349 (`MARS_WEB=1` is gone): `control-openhands browser eval "!!window.marsBridge"` is `true` and `curl -s <baseUrl>/mars/health` answers `{"ok":true,"authRequired":true}`. `F25.digitalocean-agents` and `F25.digitalocean-backend-removal` stay blocked without a DigitalOcean account.

- Cloud account: where this machine's proxy injects OpenHands Cloud credentials (`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.all-hands.dev/api/organizations` is `200` without a token), the **Cloud backend** bullet below can approve the device flow in its popup; otherwise it is blocked. Blocked here even with such an account: `F25.cloud-log-back-in` (needs a logged-out Cloud row), org switching in `F25.cloud-org-rows` (needs a second organization), the archived and error states of `F25.cloud-sandbox-states`, `F25.cloud-org-suspended` (also needs a suspended OpenHands Enterprise organization or membership), `F25.share-publicly` (toggle), and `F25.locked-cloud`, which also needs a launcher flag (see Gotchas).

- **Add Backend modal (`F25.add-backend-modal`).** Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=add-backend-menu-item'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=add-backend-modal'`: heading `Choose how you want to connect`, link `Compare Cloud, self-hosted, and Enterprise deployment options` (`/url: https://docs.openhands.dev/overview/introduction`, text `Learn more`) and tab `OpenHands Cloud ...` `[selected]` next to tab `Agent-server ...`. Keyboard focus: `control-openhands browser eval "(()=>{const a=document.activeElement;const d=document.querySelector('[data-testid=add-backend-modal]');return {tid:a.getAttribute('data-testid'),inDialog:!!(d&&d.contains(a))}})()"` is `{tid: "add-backend-close", inDialog: true}` right after opening; after eight `control-openhands browser press Tab` and three `browser press Shift+Tab` (reading the same eval after each) `inDialog` stays `true` (Tab past **Advanced** wraps to the close button), and `browser press q` then `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').textContent"` is `""` (nothing reaches the Home composer behind). `browser screenshot --feature F25.add-backend-modal --name focus-trap-open`. `control-openhands browser press Escape` leaves `browser count 'testid=add-backend-modal'` at `1`; `control-openhands browser click 'testid=add-backend-close'` makes it `0`, and `control-openhands browser eval "!!document.activeElement.closest('[data-testid=backend-selector]')"` is `true` (focus is back on the selector). Keyboard focus in a light theme: arrange `control-openhands browser eval "localStorage.setItem('openhands-color-theme','light-plus')"` and `browser reload`, reopen the modal, run `control-openhands browser focus 'testid=add-backend-option-cloud'` and `browser press ArrowRight`, then `control-openhands browser eval "getComputedStyle(document.activeElement).outlineColor"`. Expected: the theme's focus colour (`--oh-focus`, `#007ACC` in Light+). Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-13, #18324): a fixed pale `outline-blue-300` (`oklab(0.79 -0.03 -0.10)`), about 1.8:1 on the light tab (`browser screenshot 'testid=add-backend-modal' --feature F25.add-backend-modal --name tab-focus-light-plus`). Restore with `browser eval "localStorage.removeItem('openhands-color-theme')"`.

- **Device flow awaiting and Cancel (`F25.cloud-device-flow`).** Reopen Add Backend (Cloud tab, default host), run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=add-backend-login-button' --observe 'testid=add-backend-device-flow' --observe-ms 6000`, then `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=add-backend-device-flow'`. If `https://app.all-hands.dev` is reachable (`control-openhands browser network --external --last 5` lists it), the snapshot shows `Waiting for authorization...`, `Browser opened. Complete sign-in to continue. If browser didn't open, visit:`, a link `https://app.all-hands.dev/oauth/device/verify?user_code=<code>` and button `Cancel`; `browser tabs` lists a second page on that URL. Screenshot with `--feature F25.cloud-device-flow --name awaiting`, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=add-backend-auth-cancel'`: the panel is back to `Connect to OpenHands` / `Advanced` and `browser tabs` lists one page. Do not approve the code here (the **Cloud backend** bullet does, when it can). If Cloud is unreachable you get the error state of the previous bullet instead.

- **Manage list and closing (`F25.manage-backends`).** Run `browser click 'testid=backend-selector'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=manage-backends-menu-item'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=manage-backends-modal'`: heading `Manage backends`, two rows `Connected Local v1.50.1 <this run's URL> Connected Local` and `Connected QA_Second v1.50.1 <second-url> Connected Local`, each with `Edit` and `Remove`, then `Add Backend` and `Done`. `browser text 'testid=manage-backends-status-QA_Second'` is `Connected` and `browser text 'testid=manage-backends-version-QA_Second'` is `v1.50.1` (whatever `doctor` reports). Screenshot with `--feature F25.manage-backends --name list`. Focus is inside: the Add Backend bullet's focus eval with `manage-backends-modal` in place of `add-backend-modal` reads `close-manage-backends-modal` on open and stays `inDialog` `true` over nine Tabs and two Shift+Tabs (with two backends listed, Tab 8 reaches **Done** and Tab 9 wraps to the close button); after Escape, focus is back on the selector. Close it four ways, reopening between: `browser press Escape`, `control-openhands browser mouse-click 20 500` (backdrop), `browser click 'testid=close-manage-backends-modal'`, `browser click 'testid=manage-backends-done'`; each time `browser count 'testid=manage-backends-modal'` is `0`.

- **Providers tab (`F25.providers-tab`).** On the default run `browser eval "!!window.marsBridge"` is `true` (Preconditions); `curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:$(control-openhands status | jq -r .ports.frontend)/mars/health"` (the static child behind the ingress) returns the HTML index, not JSON: one bridge per stack. Open Add Backend: the tablist adds `tab "Providers Connect through DigitalOcean and more."` (`testid=add-backend-option-providers`); `control-openhands browser click 'testid=add-backend-option-providers'` and `browser snapshot 'testid=add-backend-providers-panel'` show `button "DigitalOcean Your team's OpenHands agents"` and `More providers coming soon.` (`browser screenshot --feature F25.add-backend-modal --name with-providers-tab`). At phone width the modal stays inside the viewport with the three tab titles cut to `Ope…`, `Age…`, `Pro…` (`--feature F25.providers-tab --name phone-tabs`).

- **DigitalOcean sign-in (`F25.digitalocean-sign-in`).** On the default run, run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=add-backend-provider-digitalocean'` and `browser wait 'testid=managed-agents-sign-in'`: heading `Connect your DigitalOcean team`, `textbox "Personal access token"` (`browser attr 'testid=managed-agents-token' type` is `password`), link `Create a token` (`/url: https://cloud.digitalocean.com/account/api/tokens`) and `button "Connect with token" [disabled]`; no OAuth button in a browser (`browser count 'testid=managed-agents-oauth'` is `0`). Fill `testid=managed-agents-token` with `dop_v1_qa_invalid_token_0000` and click `testid=managed-agents-token-submit`: `browser text 'testid=managed-agents-auth-error'` reads `That does not look like a DigitalOcean personal access token.` (`POST /mars/rpc/savePat` `500`). Fill a well-formed dummy, `dop_v1_` plus 64 zeros, and submit again: after a few seconds the error reads `401 Unauthorized` (`POST /mars/rpc/savePat` `401`, DigitalOcean's answer; `browser screenshot --feature F25.digitalocean-sign-in --name rejected-token`). Never type a real token here. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=add-backend-providers-back'` returns to the Providers panel (`browser count 'testid=managed-agents-sign-in'` is `0`; the providers panel itself stays mounted behind the sign-in screen, so its count is `1` either way); close with `testid=add-backend-close`. At phone width the sign-in screen fits (`bbox 'testid=add-backend-modal'` `insideViewport` `true`). Both errors also raise an error toast with the same text. Expected on a page served without a baked key (F26 `--host 0.0.0.0`, Docker), once the server's key was typed on the API-key screen: the same two answers as above. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-14, #18434): every token, even the malformed one, ends in `session key required` (`POST /mars/rpc/getAuthState` and `savePat` `401`), because the web bridge client sends only the baked page key, never the typed one; it predates #18349 (BASE with `MARS_WEB=1` fails the same way). A `--frontend-only` page connected to another stack's backend fails the same way for a different reason (the typed key belongs to the other stack); #18434 leaves that case to a maintainer decision.

- **Cloud backend (`F25.cloud-device-flow`, `F25.cloud-org-rows`, `F25.cloud-settings-link`, `F25.share-publicly`, `F25.cloud-sandbox-states`).** Only with a Cloud account (Preconditions); it creates a device grant and one conversation on that account, and shows the account's own conversations in the sidebar (keep those screenshots private). Reopen Add Backend on the Cloud tab, `browser click 'testid=add-backend-login-button'`, then `control-openhands browser tab 1` (the verify popup: `Device Authorization Request`, the code, **Authorize Device**), `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Authorize Device"]'` (`Success!`) and `control-openhands browser tab 0`. Within about 15 s (token polling answers `400` until approved, then `200`) `browser count 'testid=add-backend-modal'` is `0`, the popup is gone and `browser snapshot 'testid=backend-selector'` reads `combobox "OpenHands Cloud": OpenHands Cloud – Personal Workspace`; the registry holds `{name: "OpenHands Cloud", host: "https://app.all-hands.dev", kind: "cloud"}` (`browser eval "JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('openhands-backends')).map(b=>({name:b.name,host:b.host,kind:b.kind}))"`). Open the selector: `option "Connected OpenHands Cloud – Personal Workspace"` (one option per organization) next to `Connected Local`; Manage Backends shows the row with `Personal Workspace` and the `Cloud` pill. `browser attr 'testid=backend-selector-settings-link' href` is `https://app.all-hands.dev/settings?org=<org id>` with `target` `_blank`; clicking it opens that tab (`browser wait-tab 'app.all-hands.dev/settings'`, then `browser close-tab 1`, `browser tab 0`). Start one conversation from Home: fill `testid=chat-input` with `Reply with exactly: QA_F25_CLOUD. Do not run any tools.` and `browser click 'testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/'`: the URL is `/conversations/task-<id>` while the sandbox starts (toasts `Creating conversation…`, `Sending...`), then moves to `/conversations/<id>?backend=<cloud id>&org=<org id>` and the reply `QA_F25_CLOUD` appears (about a minute). Its `conversation-name >> ellipsis-button` menu has `share-publicly-button` (**Public Share**, off); do not flip it unless the conversation may be public. Delete it with `delete-button` and `'role=dialog >> testid=confirm-button'`, then remove the Cloud backend in Manage Backends (`manage-backends-remove-OpenHands Cloud`, confirm): after `browser reload` the selector reads `Local`.

- With the default host the device flow talks to the real `app.all-hands.dev` (`POST /oauth/device/authorize`, then token polling). Starting and cancelling is harmless; approve a code only in the **Cloud backend** bullet, with an account you may use.

- Expected: Escape never clears the backend selector. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-09, 2026-10-12, 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-14, #18233): Escape on the focused backend selector while its menu is closed (a second Escape after the one that closes the menu, and sometimes the Escape that closes Manage Backends opened from it) clears the selection: the closed selector shows the active backend's name as an italic placeholder (`browser value 'testid=backend-selector >> role=combobox'` is `""`) and its status dot is gone, so `browser wait 'testid=backend-selector >> role=status[name="Disconnected"]'` times out although the backend is down; a reload restores it. Reload before a closed-selector status check, as the Edit bullet does. Repro: `browser click 'testid=backend-selector'`, `browser press Escape` twice (#18233). On 2026-10-12 `bug proof` verified fix PR #18238 at 77de0ad24 against main f07aebdf5 (two `xfail`, two `xpass`, desktop). `control-openhands bug run F25.selector-dropdown` replays it (desktop, after a reload with the mouse off the selector: a reload under a mouse left on it opens its menu and empties its field, which would look like the bug) and reports `xfail` while the bug lasts:

- Add Backend and Manage Backends take and keep keyboard focus, and Edit backend takes it on open (`ModalBackdrop`, fixed by #18400, closed #18389; verified 2026-10-14 at desktop and phone width; at phone width open the selector with `'testid=sidebar-mobile-drawer >> testid=backend-selector'`, since the bare test id matches two selectors). At desktop width focus returns to the selector input when they close (at phone width Add Backend's X closes the drawer too and focus falls to the page body), so an Escape pressed after closing lands on the selector and can trigger #18233 below.

- `F26.mars-web-bridge`: every launcher-served web stack hosts the DigitalOcean Managed Agents bridge on its ingress by default (#18349; `MARS_WEB=1` is gone, `MARS_WEB=0` opts out): `/mars/health` answers `{"ok":true,"authRequired":true}` on a full, `--backend-only`, `--frontend-only` and `--host 0.0.0.0` launcher, `/mars/rpc/*` answers `401` without the session key and works with it, the static child behind the ingress hosts none, and the Electron stack hosts none either (its preload provides `window.marsBridge`).

- **Managed Agents bridge (`F26.mars-web-bridge`).** With both partial stacks up: `curl -s "$(control-openhands status | jq -r .baseUrl)/mars/health"`, `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18960/mars/health` and `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18970/mars/health` each print `{"ok":true,"authRequired":true}`, while `curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:$(control-openhands status | jq -r .ports.frontend)/mars/health" | head -c 15` prints `<!DOCTYPE html>` (the static child behind your run's ingress has no second bridge). `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18960/mars/rpc/getAuthState` is `401` (no key). The frontend-only page has the bridge but no key to use it: after the cross-connect, `control-openhands browser eval "({marsBridge: !!window.marsBridge, key: Boolean(window.__AGENT_CANVAS_SESSION_API_KEY__)})"` on `http://127.0.0.1:18970/` is `{marsBridge: true, key: false}` (what that does to DigitalOcean sign-in is F25's `F25.digitalocean-sign-in` known failure).

- **LAN bind (`F26.host-bind-lan`).** Start a full stack on all interfaces: `Q=$OH_VERIFY_RUN/private/f26-lan; mkdir -p $Q; HOME=$Q/home OH_CANVAS_SAFE_STATE_DIR=$Q/state OH_CANVAS_SAFE_BACKEND_PORT=18961 OH_CANVAS_SAFE_AUTOMATION_PORT=18962 OH_CANVAS_SAFE_VITE_PORT=18963 LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY=qa-f26-lan-key OH_SECRET_KEY=qa-f26-secret DO_NOT_TRACK=1 nohup node bin/agent-canvas.mjs --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18960 > $Q/launcher.log 2>&1 & echo $! > $Q/pid`, and wait until `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:18960/` is `200`. `grep -a 'not loopback' $Q/launcher.log` shows `[auth] Bind host 0.0.0.0 is not loopback — session key will not be injected into HTML` and `[static] WARNING: bind host 0.0.0.0 is not loopback; refusing to inject the session API key into HTML.` The served page proves it: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18960/ | grep -o '__AGENT_CANVAS_\(SESSION_API_KEY\|AUTH_REQUIRED\)__' | sort -u` prints only `__AGENT_CANVAS_AUTH_REQUIRED__` and `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18960/ | grep -c qa-f26-lan-key` prints `0`, while your loopback run's page, `curl -s "$(control-openhands status | jq -r .baseUrl)/" | grep -o '__AGENT_CANVAS_\(SESSION_API_KEY\|AUTH_REQUIRED\)__' | sort -u`, prints only `__AGENT_CANVAS_SESSION_API_KEY__`. The bind is real: with `LAN` from the loopback bullet, `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --connect-timeout 3 http://$LAN:18960/` is `200` here (refused on your run, `F26.loopback-bind-default`; with an empty `LAN` this check is `not-run`). The browser part below expects a profile that has never visited `127.0.0.1:18960` (true in this file's order; on a repeat pass run `control-openhands browser reset` first and restore your run afterwards, see Gotchas). Then `control-openhands browser goto http://127.0.0.1:18960/ --allow-external` and `control-openhands browser eval "({key: Boolean(window.__AGENT_CANVAS_SESSION_API_KEY__), authRequired: window.__AGENT_CANVAS_AUTH_REQUIRED__ === true})"` → `{key: false, authRequired: true}`. items.code: - **Desktop splash and window (`F26.desktop-boot-splash`, `F26.desktop-main-window`).** Start a private display and the app in one process group: `Q=$OH_VERIFY_RUN/private/f26-desktop; mkdir -p $Q/shots; setsid nohup sh -c "echo \$\$ > $Q/pgid; Xvfb :78 -screen 0 1440x1000x24 -nolisten tcp & sleep 1; DISPLAY=:78 HOME=$Q/home OH_CANVAS_SAFE_STATE_DIR=$Q/state LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY=qa-f26-desktop-key OH_SECRET_KEY=qa-f26-secret DO_NOT_TRACK=1 exec node_modules/.bin/electron --no-sandbox electron" > $Q/desktop.log 2>&1 &`, then capture frames: `for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; DISPLAY=:78 import -window root $Q/shots/s$(printf %02d $i).png; done`. Read the frames: the first seconds show the splash (logo, `OpenHands Agent Canvas`, `AI coding agent interface`, spinner, `Starting backend services…`, then lines such as `agent-server: {"asctime": ...`, the note `First launch downloads Python + the OpenHands agent server.` and a **Show details** button); a later frame shows the main window with a `File Edit View Window` menu and the first-run **Choose your agent** step under the consent dialog naming `the local backend "Local" at http://localhost:8000` (about 30 s on a warm cache, minutes on the first download). While it runs, `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/mars/health | head -c 15` prints `<!DOCTYPE html>`: the desktop stack's ingress hosts no bridge (`marsWebBridge: false`, `F26.mars-web-bridge`). Copy the frames you cite into `$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/F26.desktop-boot-splash/` and `.../F26.desktop-main-window/`. Stop in two steps: `kill -TERM $(cat $Q/pgid)` signals only the Electron launcher (it quits and stops its backend services); after about 10 s ports 8000, 18000, 18001 and 3001 are free again. Then `kill -TERM -- -$(cat $Q/pgid)` ends Xvfb; `ps -o pid,cmd -g $(cat $Q/pgid)` lists nothing.
